newsitem.title: USA: Gabelli group lifts General Host stake.
newsitem.headline: Gabelli group lifts General Host stake.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Thursday it raised its stake in General Host Corp to the equivalent of 3,408,572 common shares or 13.88 percent of the total outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of a net of 270,499 common shares between September 13 and 24 at prices ranging from $2.625 to $2.80 a share.
The group said its stake includes 1,310,518 common shares it will receive on conversion of General Host debentures that it holds.
